## Build details
Release/revision; printer; nozzle; material; layer/wall settings; slicer/version; orientation/support changes:

## Actual components
Board revision/inner-case version, measured speaker rim/depth, SEN0428 variant/stack and any substitutions:

## Coupon results
TEST01 through TEST06 and required companion parts; measurements and pass/fail notes:

## Assembly observations
Actual plugs/tools, camera corners/framing, cone excursion, retention, seal contact, service access and desk stability. Clearly mark checks not performed.

## Sensor test, if performed
Describe detached→installed→detached setup, duration and raw temperature/RH comparison. Do not present component accuracy as system accuracy.

## Files / photos
Attach only relevant parts, dimensions and cropped non-personal photos. Exclude keys, Wi-Fi details, calendars, private camera captures and device backups.
